attendance.note: Organiser-reported 14,000 visitors at the March 2026 edition (Ferias & Congresos). An exhibitor said turnout was lower than 2025. 178 exhibitors, about 400 tattoo artists.

ticket_price.note: General entry ARS 25,000 in 2026. Equipped 9 m2 stand ARS 1,500,000 incl. insurance.

notes: Large commercial tattoo expo (14,000 visitors, ARS 25,000 entry). Lead sponsor Dermaglos is a dermocosmetic skincare brand (tattoo aftercare), a health-adjacent precedent. Organiser markets stands to brands for visibility and direct sales; 2027 confirmed 19 to 21 Mar at La Rural.
